uncovered.points: 174 points: io_perf_*_value[1..5] and the perf_3/perf_7 pipeline bits
evidence: Leaf stage perf outputs zero-extend delayed booleans. NewLoadUnit.sv:1138-1159 forwards stage events through 6-bit registers; upper bits settle to zero but can have random initialization transients

NewLoadUnit.sv:1152-1153,4011 forwards S2 perf3 as parent perf7. S2 defect LSU-HWPF-MISS-001 is proven dynamically only at the exposed S2 boundary; generated parent has no direct hardware-prefetch injection port
174 residual raw points are a mixed group, not 174 harmless constants or 174 independent bugs; no denominator is removed

the parent has no prefetchReq port, so the hi-confidence prefetch lane (entrance 0x10) and the low-confidence lane (0x80 as a real beat) are constant-eliminated in S0's arbiter (docs/contracts/load-arbiter.md)
entrance bit 5 (0x20) is not produced by any lane; bit 7 only exists as the arbiter bubble default, but pipeOut is registered only when a lane is valid
S0 forces the fast lane's entrance[2] with OR 3'h4 (LoadUnitS0.sv), so that bit can never fall

uncovered.points: 54 points on tail vaddr/fullva[0..3] and mask[15]
evidence: LoadUnitS1.sv: unalignTail.vaddr = {46'(vaddr[49:4]+1), 4'h0} and fullva = {60'(fullva[63:4]+1), 4'h0}
LoadUnitS1.sv: unalignTail.mask = {1'h0, shifted[30:16]} - bit 15 is a literal zero and only spilled bytes are representable
cross-16B directed tests confirm the tail always lands on a line boundary

uncovered.points: 24 points on dcache_req cmd/instrtype high bits
evidence: LoadUnitS0.sv: cmd = {3'h0, instrType[2], 1'h0} and instrtype = {2'h0, {2{instrType[2]}}}
only cmd[1] and instrtype[1:0] are driven

uncovered.points: 12 points on LQ cause 7 and cause 12
evidence: LoadUnitS3.sv encodes 11 replay causes onto bits 0..6 and 8..11; bit 7 and bit 12 are tied to zero (see docs/gaps/load_s3.json LS3-CAUSE7-12-NOT-ENCODED)
a training beat requires entrance[6]|entrance[5]; those codes (0x40/0x44) are only produced by the scalar lane and by fast replays of scalar beats
the scalar lane's pftType[1] is the literal 1 (LoadUnitS0.sv), so isHwPrefetch = instrType[2] & ~pftType[1] is always 0 on a training beat
isFirstIssue = entrance[6]|entrance[5] is therefore always 1 on a valid train and stays 1 in the register

semantic_findings.finding: the TLB response must be presented in the cycle the beat sits in S1, not when S0 issues the request
evidence: the first probes drove the response with ldin and observed cause_3 replays; adding the response one cycle later produced the expected ldout
this matches LoadUnitS1.sv (tlbResp is sampled together with pipeIn)
semantic_findings.impact: any parent-level stimulus must schedule responses with pipeline latency; the tests do so

semantic_findings.finding: S3's ldout/vldout/lqWrite are combinational from its pipeIn, so the writeback is visible in the same cycle the beat enters S3
evidence: the aligned load writes back 3 edges after ldin (ldin t0, S1 t1, S2 t2, S3 t2 comb)
LoadUnitS3.sv: ldoutValid = pipeIn_valid & writebackArmed & ~vecWen & ~cancel
semantic_findings.impact: the parent timing table records this; tests assert the writeback at that cycle

semantic_findings.finding: the head+tail merge appears on the datapath output one cycle before the merged LQ entry is written
evidence: cross-16B test: the S3 input is the head while the datapath output already holds head|tail; the LQ write with the head address/cause happens on the following edge
datapath s4ShiftHead is loaded from the head's rotated data at the tail's S3 capture
semantic_findings.impact: both values are checked (the merged data at the writeback cycle and the tail-line mask in the LQ stream)

old_entries.points: 21 points on cause_0/cause_11/fastReplayNukeFirst in child instance port copies
evidence: these points are reported inside LoadUnitS1/S3 port lists; cause_0 is only generated by S2 (never by S1) and cause_11 is generated by S1 and captured by S2, so the child copies that never carry the value cannot toggle
the functionally meaningful copies are exercised: the uncache test asserts lqWrite cause_0, the nuke tests assert cause_11, and the nuke-first test drives fastReplayNukeFirst
the same child points are covered by the corresponding leaf UT runs (load-s1/s2/s3 final runs) with their own denominators

LoadUnitS3.sv: allowRRBankConflictFastReplay is a combinational wire that is high only while the granted bank-conflict replay is in S3; the post-edge sampling point never observes the falling half (the wire is recomputed from the next beat)
the RR replay behaviour itself is verified by test xstage.fast_replay_reenters_pipeline (the beat is not committed and later re-enters)
